gripOrHq.title: Viral Pipeline
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

gripOrHq.title: Sunburst Cranial Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Provides +1 MU and +1 hand size. Put [1] from the bank on Cranial Interface when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

gripOrHq.title: Cortical Stimulators
gripOrHq.rulesText: Prevents 1 Net or brain damage each turn.

gripOrHq.title: Big Frackin' Gun
gripOrHq.rulesText: [6]: Break up to five sentry subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength

heapOrArchives.title: All-Hands
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, access three additional cards from HQ. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

heapOrArchives.title: Disgruntled Ice Technician
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. After passing a piece of ice during this run, you may derez that ice and end your run if you broke all the subroutines of that ice.

rig.title: Highlighter
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Wrecking Ball
rig.rulesText: [0]: Break wall subroutine. [2]: +1 strength. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Wrecking Ball, lose [1] from a stealth card.

rig.title: Fubar
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break a subroutine of the type chosen for Fubar. [2]: +1 strength. [0]: Choose whether Fubar breaks code gates, sentries, or walls. Use this ability only once. Whenever you break an ice subroutine with Fubar, lose [1] from a stealth card.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: Executive Extraction
scoreArea.rulesText: Difficulty of Gray Ops agendas is reduced by 1.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Downsizing
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

root.title: Management Shake-Up
root.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: Pacifica Regional AI
root.rulesText:
You may advance Pacifica Regional AI before and after you rez it.
Regional AI advancement counter: Gain an action. Use this ability only during your turn.
